summary: All obligations remain disposed with no pending work and audit-unit capacity exhausted, so this step continues the authorized source work on the deferred transport surface by reading the two largest remaining unread blocks: the outbound connection lifecycle and the inbound dispatch path. Submission is a feedback-only research product (no map version). Outbound: getConn reuses a pooled connection for the target and otherwise dials through the StreamLayer with n.timeout, wrapping it in a buffered writer plus msgpack encoder/decoder (net_transport.go 403-430); genericRPC sends the typed RPC and calls decodeResponse, returning the connection to the pool only when the response decoded cleanly (496-506), so a connection whose response failed mid-stream is released instead of pooled; returnConn keeps at most maxPool connections per target and releases the rest (434-446); InstallSnapshot deliberately never reuses its connection (509-511). Inbound: each accepted connection decodes one type byte, decodes the typed request into an RPC with a one-buffered response channel (640-716), classifies an AppendEntries as a heartbeat only when the term is non-zero, a leader address is present and the previous-log coordinate, entry list and commit index are all zero (665-680), routes a heartbeat to the callback snapshot taken under the mutex when installed (724-733), and otherwise blocks on the consumer channel send with a shutdown escape before waiting for the response and writing the error string followed by the response on the same connection (735-767). The recorded consequence is that this per-connection serialisation is what makes the pipeline's FIFO response-order assumption hold. The feedback states plainly that nothing was evaluated for defects. Remaining list keeps the surface deferred: the consumer channel's capacity and back-pressure policy, getPooledConn's body (whether a pooled connection can be handed to two callers concurrently), StreamLayer and its TCP/TLS wiring plus the stream context and CloseStreams behaviour, InmemTransport's in-process delivery and ordering semantics, and the un-re-checked heartbeat classification against what the leader actually emits, alongside the previously recorded open items (installSnapshot reachability, the compacted-leader variant, and execution corroboration of the two reading-based consequences). Preflight validation returns valid with no diagnostics.
